why: Tier-1 CI tooling only: scripts/ci/check_research_queue_health.py (RESEARCH-LOOP-AUDIT RC4). Refill capacity counts ready programme nodes; an unfillable H1 with a non-empty programme authoring queue is H1-AUTHOR (warn, exit 0); the floor is computed from fired_24h (19 h of supply, never below 25) but a page still needs runnable < 25 (H1-THIN warns between the two), so paging frequency does not rise; idle backends from the newest utilization record are printed. Reads the programme fields with .get(), so it is correct before and after the programme-source PR. No workflow, schedule, config/, src/ or live path.
